arcNotes: Opinion caller with credentials but no experience. Vern concedes the reporting-chill is REAL (career/medical-cert fear), reframes it from conspiracy to incentive design, shares ASRS as the workaround. Respectful peer-to-peer close

lines.text: Commercial, twelve years, ATP. I've never seen anything and I fly the same routes as the guys who have. That's the point. The difference isn't the sky, it's what happens after. Those leaked from controllers and Navy crews because those jobs don't have a medical certificate hanging over them.

lines.text: That is the most credible argument I've heard all week, and you should know it's also documented.
